profile.name: Rohit Raj Yadav
profile.title: Software Engineer 2
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 2.8+ years of experience building scalable backend systems and AI-powered products for legal and healthcare enterprises using .NET, Node.js, Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, and Redis. Experienced in architecting production-grade RAG systems, distributed workflows, and low-latency backend architectures focused on scalability and reliability.

achievements: Built a stateful multi-tenant invoice lifecycle orchestration system with an LLM-driven decision layer to recommend and trigger actions (review, adjustment, approval, rollback, summarization), reducing manual effort by 80%.

Designed a CQRS-based rule engine for 100+ invoice adjustment policies, separating command and query paths to improve scalability and consistency, reducing manual interventions by 60%. Integrated Redis caching to optimize rule evaluation latency.
Modernized ASPX-based invoice workflows to React in a multi-tenant setup, improving UI responsiveness and reducing page load time by 25%.
Optimized invoice ingestion pipelines using MessagePack serialization for Excel/LEDES files, reducing processing latency by 30%.
Built event-driven, multi-tenant invoice processing pipelines using RabbitMQ, enabling 50K+ daily operations with high reliability and at-least-once processing.
Developed secure and scalable Java REST APIs using Spring Boot for microservices handling 10K+ data-sharing transactions, ensuring consistent performance with latency under 300ms.
Optimized backend performance by tuning SQL queries using indexing strategies and table-valued functions, reducing database load and improving system responsiveness by up to 40%.

highlights: Implemented domain-specialized AI agents for macroeconomics, sector analysis, fundamentals, technical indicators, and sentiment signals.
Aggregated signals into an automated conviction scoring engine for multi-factor investment insights.
Processed data across 12+ market segments in real time.

highlights: Designed scalable ingestion and embedding pipelines with async processing and vector search using pgvector.
Added a Redis caching layer and multi-provider LLM fallback for resilient, low-latency retrieval.
Enabled processing of 100+ documents with low-latency Q&A workflows.
